A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the immunogenicity of recombinant products is not significantly higher than that of plasma-derived products, and the immunogenicity is mainly determined by product-specific properties, including the presence of von Wille-brand factor, the purity of the product, and its manufacturing process.
the use of recombinant products in patients with a high risk of developing inhibitors is safe and effective.

The main takeaway from our work is that

von Wille-Brand factor is not the only factor that influences the risk of developing inhibitors to factor VIII, but that the risk of inhibitor formation is influenced by a multitude of genetic and environmental factors.
